en: To say something to someone; or to give information; or to order someone to do something.
ex: Please tell me where the station is.
請告訴我車站在哪裡。

en: A building used for worship, especially in Asian religions; or the flat part on the side of your forehead.
ex: We visited an old temple on the mountain.
我們參觀了山上的一座古廟。

en: A sport in which two or four players hit a ball over a net with rackets.
ex: My brother plays tennis every Saturday.
我哥哥每個星期六打網球。

en: Very bad or unpleasant; or very serious.
ex: The weather was terrible, so we stayed home.
天氣很糟，所以我們待在家裡。

en: A set of questions to measure knowledge; or an examination of something to see if it works; or to try something.
ex: We have an English test next Monday.
下星期一我們有英語考試。

en: Used to compare two things or people.
ex: My brother is taller than me.
我哥哥比我高。

en: To tell someone that you are grateful for something they have done; or an expression of gratitude.
ex: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
謝謝你幫我做功課。

en: Used to point to a person or thing farther away; or to join two parts of a sentence.
ex: That is my brother standing over there.
站在那邊的是我哥哥。

en: Used before nouns to show that you are talking about something specific that is known.
ex: The sun rises in the east.
太陽從東方升起。

en: A building where you watch films or plays; or a large room with seats for lectures.
ex: We went to the theater to see a new play.
我們去劇院看了一齣新戲。

en: At that time; or after that; or in that case.
ex: First we ate dinner, and then we watched a film.
我們先吃晚餐，然後看了一部電影。

en: In, at or to that place; or used to start a sentence when you point something out.
ex: The bank is over there, next to the post office.
銀行在那邊，郵局旁邊。

en: Used to talk about people or things that are near you.
ex: These are my best friends, Tom and Mary.
這些是我最好的朋友，湯姆和瑪麗。

en: Used to talk about more than one person or thing that have already been mentioned.
ex: They are my neighbors, and their house is next to mine.
他們是我的鄰居，他們的房子就在我家隔壁。

en: Having a large distance between two opposite sides; or having a lot of hair or fog; or stupid.
ex: She wore a thick coat in the cold weather.
她在寒冷的天氣穿著厚外套。

en: Not thick; or having little fat on the body; or not dense.
ex: She is thin and tall like her father.
她像她父親一樣又瘦又高。

en: An object or something that is not named; or an event, fact or action.
ex: What is that strange thing on the table?
桌上那個奇怪的東西是什麼？

en: To have an opinion; or to use your mind to form ideas; or to remember something.
ex: I think it is going to rain this afternoon.
我覺得今天下午會下雨。

en: Coming after the second in order; or one of three equal parts.
ex: She won third place in the race.
她在比賽中獲得第三名。

en: Used to point to a person or thing that is near; or used to mean the present one.
ex: This is my new bike, and that is my old one.
這是我的新腳踏車，那是我的舊車。

en: Used to talk about people or things that are farther away.
ex: Those are the best apples in the market.
那些是市場裡最好的蘋果。

en: Despite the fact that; or however.
ex: Though it was raining, we went out to play.
雖然在下雨，我們還是出去玩。

en: The number 1,000; or a very large number of something.
ex: There are more than a thousand students in this school.
這所學校有一千多名學生。

en: The tube at the back of your mouth that carries food and air; or the front part of your neck.
ex: I have a sore throat and a cough.
我喉嚨痛又咳嗽。

en: From one end or side of something to the other; or by means of; or finished.
ex: We drove through the tunnel to reach the other side.
我們開車穿過隧道到另一邊。

en: To send something through the air with force from your hand; or to put something away.
ex: Don't throw rubbish on the street.
別在街上亂丟垃圾。

en: A piece of paper that shows you have paid to travel or enter a place; or a label; or a notice for breaking the law.
ex: I bought two tickets for the concert.
我買了兩張音樂會的票。

en: Neat and well arranged; or to make a place neat and well arranged.
ex: Please tidy your room before the guests arrive.
客人來之前請把你的房間整理好。

en: A narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck with a shirt; or to fasten with a knot; or a game with the same score.
ex: He wore a blue tie with a white shirt.
他穿著白襯衫，打了條藍領帶。

en: A large wild cat with orange fur and black stripes that lives in Asia.
ex: The tiger is one of the largest cats in the world.
老虎是世界上最大的貓科動物之一。

en: What is measured in hours, days and years; or a particular moment; or how often something happens.
ex: What time does the movie start?
電影幾點開始？

en: The pointed end of something; or extra money given to a waiter; or a useful piece of advice.
ex: We left a tip for the waiter.
我們給服務生留了小費。

en: Feeling that you want to rest or sleep; or bored with something.
ex: I am tired because I stayed up late last night.
我很累，因為昨晚熬夜了。

en: Used to show direction, place or limit; or used before a verb in its basic form.
ex: I walk to school every morning.
我每天早上走路去上學。

en: This day; or the present time.
ex: What is the date today?
今天幾月幾號？

en: One of the five parts at the end of your foot; or the front part of a shoe or sock.
ex: I hurt my toe when I kicked the table.
我踢到桌子，弄傷了腳趾。

en: With another person or thing; or at the same time; or in one group.
ex: We study together at the library every weekend.
我們每個週末一起在圖書館念書。

en: A room or a bowl-shaped seat where you get rid of body waste; or a room with this in it.
ex: May I go to the toilet, please?
我可以去上廁所嗎？

en: A round, soft, red fruit that is eaten raw in salads or cooked in sauces.
ex: She sliced a tomato for the sandwich.
她切了一顆番茄做三明治。

en: The day after today; or the future.
ex: We have a school trip tomorrow.
我們明天有校外教學。
